spec.selection: Vulkan core 1.0; extension conditional sections excluded

rows.requirement: Require D16 depth attachment support, at least one X8_D24/D32 depth attachment format, and at least one D24S8/D32S8 combined attachment format; the experimental D24S8 choice alone covers neither complete minimum set.
rows.falsifier: Query mandatory format combinations against the pinned core format tables.
rows.experimental_status: residual public obligation; the advertised D24S8 route does not supply Vulkan 1.0 mandatory depth-format coverage

rows.requirement: Vulkan 1.0 minimum maxImageDimension2D is 4096; a 64x64 experimental image is an evidence bound rather than an advertised conformant limit.
rows.falsifier: Compare every exposed image/framebuffer/sample limit with mandatory minima.
rows.experimental_status: residual public obligation; physical limits and D24S8 format bounds remain below the complete Vulkan 1.0 conformance envelope

rows.requirement: Validate image type, extent, layers, mip levels, sample count, tiling, usage and format query consistency for depth/stencil images.
rows.falsifier: Create legal and illegal parameter combinations; compare supported queries and creation.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; RS485M D24S8 optimal 2D images with one mip, one layer, one sample and extent at most 64x64

rows.requirement: Honor memory requirements, alignment, offsets, type bits, complete binding and lifetime; retain image storage across permitted rebinding of attachments.
rows.falsifier: Exercise nonzero binding offsets and distinct live allocations with guard checks.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; aligned suballocation binding validates the tiled depth footprint and preserves image-owned state

rows.requirement: Validate view format and depth/stencil aspect selection; keep logical aspects distinct from packed physical storage.
rows.falsifier: Create depth-only, stencil-only and combined views; verify permitted uses and preserved sibling aspects.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; depth, stencil and combined views select logical aspects over packed D24S8 storage

rows.requirement: Implement depth enable, all compare operators and write enable independently, including disabled-test write behavior.
rows.falsifier: Cross product of compare operations, test enable and write enable against a reference.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; depth comparison and write-enable lowering covers the admitted static D24S8 pipeline state

rows.requirement: Implement front/back stencil comparisons, reference and masks, fail/depth-fail/pass operations and write masking.
rows.falsifier: Exercise all stencil operators with front/back faces and independently varied masks.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; static front and back operations share hardware state while ordered primitive segments select their distinct references and masks

rows.requirement: Apply static/dynamic stencil references and masks according to pipeline declarations and command ordering.
rows.falsifier: Alternate pipelines and dynamic commands; verify state lifetime across draws.
rows.experimental_status: residual public obligation; dynamic stencil reference and mask commands remain refused

rows.requirement: Depth bounds is feature-conditional; support enabled behavior when exposed and reject unsupported feature enablement.
rows.falsifier: Exercise advertised feature gating and inclusive bounds oracle.
rows.experimental_status: residual public obligation; depth-bounds testing remains feature-disabled

rows.requirement: Honor depth loadOp/storeOp independently of stencilLoadOp/stencilStoreOp; LOAD preserves defined input and STORE preserves output.
rows.falsifier: Test all depth load/store pairs while checking stencil bytes remain governed by their own operations.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; render-pass depth load and store operations are selected independently in the admitted one-subpass shape

rows.requirement: Honor stencil load/store independently; DONT_CARE does not authorize damage to an independently preserved aspect.
rows.falsifier: Cross all stencil/depth operation pairs and inspect both aspects.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; render-pass stencil load and store operations are selected independently with packed sibling preservation

rows.requirement: Clear requested depth/stencil aspects only within declared attachment rectangles/layers and render-pass constraints.
rows.falsifier: Clear depth-only and stencil-only rectangles with sibling-aspect and exterior preservation oracles.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; in-pass color and depth/stencil rectangle clears retain command order and validate logical bounds

rows.requirement: Honor depth/stencil aspect ranges, transfer-destination usage and allowed layouts with correct clear-value conversion.
rows.falsifier: Clear each aspect and combined ranges, checking untouched subresources and packed sibling bits.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; depth-only, stencil-only and combined range clears normalize aspect requests and preserve the packed sibling

rows.requirement: Preserve requested depth/stencil aspects and valid compatible image formats; apply Vulkan1.0 core dimensional/layer rules without maintenance1 relaxations.
rows.falsifier: Copy aspects between distinct offsets/images; verify sibling aspects, layer ranges and exact defined bits.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; resolver-addressed depth-only and stencil-only image copies support tiled whole-tile and partial regions with overlap checks

rows.requirement: D24 buffer depth uses low 24 bits of a 32-bit word, unlike hardware high-24 packing; honor row/image strides, aspect selection and copy bounds in both directions.
rows.falsifier: Round-trip D24 through buffers with nontrivial strides; compare defined low24 bits and stencil preservation.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; depth buffer copies use the packed high-24 byte span through the aspect-copy planner

rows.requirement: Stencil buffer copies use one S8 byte per texel and preserve the depth aspect.
rows.falsifier: Round-trip all byte values through offset and strided copies with depth sentinels.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; stencil buffer copies address one low-byte component and preserve packed depth

rows.requirement: Gate blits by format features and depth/stencil format/filter restrictions; copies do not imply filtering support.
rows.falsifier: Compare queried blit support and accepted commands with depth/stencil format and nearest-filter rules.
rows.experimental_status: residual public obligation; D24S8 blit execution and its complete format-feature admission remain outside the route

rows.requirement: Implement core depth/stencil attachment, read-only, transfer and general layouts with combined-image aspect rules; separate depth/stencil layouts require extensions outside this scope.
rows.falsifier: Transition attachment/transfer/read-only sequences and verify contents plus valid aspect masks.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; GENERAL, transfer and depth attachment/read-only layouts use ordered API state for the admitted combined image

rows.requirement: Provide availability and visibility across early/late fragment tests, transfer and host access; cache publication must follow Vulkan access scopes.
rows.falsifier: Alternate GPU writes, attachment reads, copies and host inspection with explicit dependencies.
rows.experimental_status: bounded public route; cross-engine memory barriers emit conservative ZB, RB3D, RB2D cache publication and idle packets

rows.requirement: Honor external/inter-subpass execution and memory dependencies and automatic layout transitions.
rows.falsifier: Load data from preceding writes across subpasses with defined dependency scopes.
rows.experimental_status: residual public obligation; the route covers external dependencies around one subpass and refuses inter-subpass execution

rows.requirement: Retain resources until completed submissions; honor semaphore/fence and queue ownership rules within advertised queue families.
rows.falsifier: Submit image reuse/destruction and ownership scenarios against completion and lifetime controls.
rows.experimental_status: residual public obligation; semaphore, fence and queue-ownership coverage remains incomplete for general Vulkan workloads

rows.requirement: Honor EarlyFragmentTests execution mode and its depth/stencil side effects, including discard and shader-written depth rules.
rows.falsifier: Use early-test shaders with discard, side effects and depth output; compare order-sensitive expected images.
rows.experimental_status: residual public obligation; shader discard, early-test side effects and public execution coverage remain incomplete

rows.requirement: Preserve late depth/stencil semantics for shader depth output, discard and side effects; early execution is legal only when observationally equivalent.
rows.falsifier: Use depth replacement and discard shaders with stencil updates and visible side effects.
rows.experimental_status: residual public obligation; shader depth output, discard and late-test ordering remain outside qualified public execution
